title: DnD Tavern Simulator, Dark Sun Creator's Competitor, Heroscape Dungeon Crawl Mode – TTRPG News 8/28/2026
summary: New DnD video game announcement, a sort-of Dark Sun book from an original creator, a story-driven Kickstarter TTRPG with interesting influences, and Heroscape joins the dungeon crawl club. ‍
body_markdown:
This week in tabletop RPG’s biggest headlines: a new DnD video game announcement, a sort-of Dark Sun book from an original creator, a story-driven Kickstarter TTRPG with interesting influences, and Heroscape joins the dungeon crawl club.


### **DnD Video Game Puts You In Charge Of A Tavern**


Gamescom 2027 brought the surprise reveal of a new **Dungeons & Dragons video game** . It’s a business sim/cozy game that gives you a struggling tavern to build up into a proper rest stop. The game is called **Dungeons & Dragons: Long Rest Tavern** and comes out in 2027. The trailer shows the player hiring NPCs, sending adventurers on quests to gather ingredients, and placing furniture around the tavern. It looks like a good partner to *Warlock* , a **cozy DnD game** to offset the action-focused game.


### **Dark Sun Co-Creator Brings Spiritual Successor To BackerKit**


via BackerKit


Timothy Brown, a co-creator of the original **Dark Sun** , is bringing out another **post-apocalyptic DnD setting** just in time to rival WotC’s Dark Sun revival. Brown’s setting is called *Dragon Kings* and features a foreboding land of sand and ruins. There’s psionics, insect people, and a harsh desert wasteland. There’s even art from Brom, a key contributor to the Dark Sun aesthetic. The major differences according to the[BackerKit page](https://www.backerkit.com/c/projects/strange-owl-games/dragon-kings/pre-launch?) is that *Dragon Kings* is more hopeful and system agnostic. There will be conversion rules available to play in **DnD 2e** .


### **Sine Merges Last Of Us, Avatar, And Halo Into A Cinematic TTRPG**


via Kickstarter


A new **story-driven TTRPG** is coming to Kickstarter, and it takes inspiration from an odd yet potentially cohesive set of worlds. *Sine* presents a doomed Earth taken over by aliens. Players take on the role of genetically engineered super-soldiers tasked with taking the planet back and rebuilding society. According to the[press release](https://www.rascal.news/halo-meets-the-last-of-us-in-this-new-ttrpg/) , it takes cures from ***Halo* , *The Last of U* s, Nickelodeon’s**[Avatar](https://startplaying.games/play/avatar-legends-the-rpg) **, and *The 100*** . The system uses d6 dice and a d20 for luck.


### **Heroscape Releases Free Dungeon Crawler Mode**


via Renegade Game Studio


Cult classic wargame ***Heroscape*** is getting into the dungeon crawler game with a set of free scenarios. ***Heroscape: Expeditions*** provides new rules for using the same Heroscape figures, with the goal being to grab treasure instead of obliterating another player’s army. The dungeon maps, rules, and pre-made scenarios can all be[downloaded for free on Renegade’s website](https://heroscape.renegadegamestudios.com/scenarios) . According to ICv2, ***Expeditions*** content will be updated monthly. The goal for Renegade is to introduce new players through the dungeon crawls and then move them to competitive play.


‍


I love me a good miniatures game! A *Heroscape* RPG would be a fun time, look into it Renegade! Until next time, may your dice be kind.


*Sergio Solórzano is the*[best Dungeon Master in the USA](https://startplaying.games/gm/actionsergdm) *(according to*[an official D&D competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Be7rLQykfw4) *, anyway). He loves minis and terrain but also goes all-in on improv!*
